scenario: LSCP.2.5.2 — a rule that matches a `scope ambient` schema loads AND fires on the native Rete engine. The loader registers an in-file ambient schema on BOTH the Rete side (so the alpha node binds) and the DS WM side (so the host can assert its facts). A compiler that emits no atoms for an ambient schema gets -101 from ds_engine_load_dsc. Pin: assert one MedSchedule ambient fact, pump; rule `due` emits a MedAlert; fact_count 2 (MedSchedule + MedAlert) confirms load + match + fire.
rules_ds:
schema MedSchedule scope logical ambient:
    id: String key

schema MedAlert scope logical:
    note: String key

rule due:
    MedSchedule
->
    emit MedAlert logical note: "due"
